question: If the code for LOCK is written as LAND POWER TACT AWAKE, then which of the given options will be the code for POST?
solution:
The logic is here:

**L O C K**

**1 2 3 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd1a8e70e6933c6b4565b4e770c3285940449bd4bcdc0b257f6cb1ca70b186a2.png] 

Similarly,

**P O S T**

1 2 3 4

Now check option (2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91ca216d1736788dc554eb8b1e8a93e4eacaf070827d7ca2b1f5c44ea4ff8990.png]
